title: HelperSessionAttachResult
description: Result of the helper session service's attach op: the attachment that was minted, where the reader now stands, and whether it may write. Three fields for three concerns — conflating any two of them is the defect this ABI exists to prevent. The attachment is disposable and never reaches the ledger; the resume is about the stream, which outlives it; the grant is about the one writer, which is neither.
